why: The case's must_catch list has one item. It needs a FAIL result that names the missing line about CSV staying unchanged (or npm test still passing), backed by a wrong build that breaks CSV. The output's overall result is "FAIL", and the first line is marked FAIL. Its wrong build calls "parse(input, '\t') whether or not --tsv is given", which "breaks default CSV mode". It also notes that "no line requires `npm test` to pass". It names the missing line: "plain CSV without --tsv still gives the same output and npm test passes". The wrong_build field repeats this as "CSV without --tsv keeps its current output (npm test passes)". So the one required item is fully covered.
